comment: Relay hook registrations. Both hooks ship REGISTERED DISABLED: the owner starts the loops with an explicit enable, which doubles as the start/stop switch. Path home is .opencode/hooks/relay/, disjoint from the sibling-owned .opencode/skills/relay-protocol/ tree. No chat ids, tokens, or database ids are stored here; the owner places them in local config at install time.

hooks.wakePolicy: worker wakes ONLY on new activity; silent ticks cost one query and wake nothing
alerts on status=pending AND expected_reply_by in the past; approval_request rows always alert and are never auto-approved
